title: Sample: GSA OASIS+ Pool 2 Awards Recompete Window
description: GSA's OASIS+ Pool 2 awards reset the small-business clock. Here's the recompete window everyone is missing.
capture_corner_teaser: If you're a Pool 2 SDVOSB, your re-compete window opens 18 months out — start the LDP conversations now.
capture_corner: Pool 2 SDVOSB awardees should map their option-period exhaust dates against the GSA Schedule MAS refresh calendar. The two interact — anyone caught in the wrong order loses 90 days of capture momentum.

If you teamed in Pool 2 as a sub, the prime relationship you locked in 2025 is the one that carries you through 2027. New LDP relationships are unlikely to add value before the next recompete; double down on the existing prime.
body_markdown:
I sat in on a GSA industry day last week and heard the quiet part out loud. The GSA contracting officer running OASIS+ Pool 2 said — and I am going to say this like I heard it — "the small businesses who win Pool 2 will be measured against the same recompete cadence as the unrestricted pool."

That line is buried in the Section L instructions and most awardees missed it.

Here's why it matters.
